en.headline: Snooker star Jimmy White becomes Hong Kong resident via talent scheme
en.dek: The English player known as ‘The Whirlwind’ obtained his identity card through the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme and said he plans to open a snooker academy in the city.
body: The Immigration Department announced on Wednesday that snooker legend Jimmy White has become a Hong Kong resident under the Quality Migrant Admission Scheme. He recently completed formalities and received his Hong Kong identity card.

White, nicknamed ‘The Whirlwind’ for his fast attacking style, joins fellow English stars Ronnie O’Sullivan and Judd Trump, who earlier obtained residency through the same scheme. The department posted a video of White attending its office for fingerprinting and photography.

In the video White said he plans to open a snooker academy in Hong Kong to find and nurture local talent and to promote the sport. He also recalled appearing as himself in the 1991 Hong Kong film Legend of the Dragon alongside Stephen Chow and expressed interest in catching up with an ‘old friend’.
White has won 23 professional titles, including 10 ranking events, and was runner-up at the World Snooker Championship six times.

zh.headline: 桌球名將占美韋德成香港居民 擬開桌球學院
zh.dek: 有「白旋風」之稱的英國桌球手透過優秀人才入境計劃取得香港身份證，表示計劃在港開設桌球學校培育本地人才。
body: 入境事務處周三公布，殿堂級桌球名將占美韋德（Jimmy White）較早前已透過優秀人才入境計劃正式成為香港居民，並在入境處辦理手續取得香港身份證。
韋德以快速華麗的球風被稱為「白旋風」，是繼奧蘇利雲及卓林普等英國名將之後，再有桌球手經同一計劃取得居留權。入境處在社交平台上載片段，顯示他到處內打指模及拍照。
韋德在片段中表示，計劃在香港開設桌球學院，發掘及培育本地桌球人才，並推廣這項運動。他憶及1991年以本名參演電影《龍的傳人》，與周星馳同場打桌球，並說希望與「老朋友」敍舊。
韋德共奪得23個職業賽事冠軍，包括10次排名賽冠軍，並曾六度屈居世界桌球錦標賽亞軍。
